The '''Icehang Loop''' was an area in the [[Highmount Ridge]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. A looping pathway located underneath a fractured ice overhang, it was home to numerous [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]], and [[Shai Tenna's pleasure den]] was located in the loop.
